artwork_title: Balloon Fiesta
provenance: From the Private Collection of John E. Lawler. As the official artist of the 30th Anniversary Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta poster, John Nieto was commissioned by the organization to create this original iconic artwork to celebrate the 2001 Balloon Fiesta. The image was then reproduced as limited edition prints as well as posters and other promotional items for the larger mass market. The present lot was on extended loan to the Albuquerque International Sunport airport, where it was on display to countless travelers and New Mexican natives for nearly a quarter century.

provenance: Acquired directly from the artist by the consignor's father, who studied painting together with Scholder under Robert Else, Tarmo Pasto, and Raymond Witt at Sacramento State College. In 1961, Scholder received a full Rockefeller Foundation scholarship under the Southwest Indian Art Project at the University of Arizona. In describing how the work was purchased from Scholder as he was preparing to depart California, the consignor's father recounted: "All he owned was a big old black Packard, and that was how he, his wife and little boy moved to [Arizona].
